name: MujinaControl-S19
notes: Current fable placement retained. Board updated from the schematic on 2026-11-10: 310 footprints, including accessory header J15 and the three hashboard supply switches (U150-U152 with 20 passives), placed but not routed; no existing footprint or track moved. Fresh SPI NAND bus, six regulator local circuits, SoC bypass/grounds and accessory local connections saved. 374 tracks; 255 vias, all 0.45/0.30 mm. 12 V input, protected fan supply, their ground return and the 5 V rail to the regulators are now copper zones (see docs/routing-current.md). 450 unconnected items; 67 existing other DRC findings; unchanged Q1 metadata parity warning. Six-layer nominal 1.6 mm, ENIG, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner. 3 A per fan, input stage for four fans plus board, 5 V system budget 2 A. Global power distribution, other interfaces and clock circuits remain unfinished. Not for ordering. See docs/routing-current.md. Old routing documents describe the pre-ripup board.
